This is a good question. Perhaps Bob or Jeff can help us here.

An HOE is confounded from your simple description by the reference angle. If you want to make it act just like the lens you need to carefully plan the reference and object beams. Now what I fine equally interesting is it is posible to create an HOE of a lens (Or a mirror for that matter) with two spatial filters on two beams. 

I really need someone to write up some basic HOE concepts for the wiki. Other than playing with it I hvae no experience.
